engine: oxp/MECHANICS.md: hands, the ten combo groups, the damage pipeline, Nerve, Counter, the attack timer, the gauge, Limit Tokens, two lives, the 30 s clock. Unchanged. Academy mode is retired.

seat.rule: The colour a seat brings is the colour of its gem. Class is cosmetic: the drawing, the clips, the Limit Breaker cut-in.
seat.duplicateGems: A second or third seat of one gem deepens the one passive a step; copies never stack.

map.nodesPerRow: 3 in rows 1–4 and 6–9; 1 in rows 5 and 10

bosses.5: The Blind Judge of the Palate

map.secretRow: Row 11, the Critic: appears for a table that clears row 10 with both lives and at least one Limit Token banked.
map.vote: Majority; a tie goes to seat 1, rotating each row.
generation: Each node connects to one or two nodes in the next row; every node is reachable; at least two full paths share no node outside the boss rows.
Rows 1–4 draw from the Starter pool, rows 6–9 from the Main pool; no monster twice on one map.
Every row has one safe node (modifier weight ≤ 1) and one hot node (weight ≥ 3).
Exactly one Elite in rows 2–4 and one in rows 7–9: +30% HP, two modifiers, relic floor Rare.
map.rewardTier: Points × (1 + 0.15 × total modifier weight). Relic floor: weight 0–2 Common, 3–4 Rare, 5+ Epic.
map.afterEveryFight: Relic vote (three offered, four in Leftovers hour or after an Elite), Nerve to 100, hands refilled. A lost life restarts the encounter, not the map.

augmentLayers.t: Each seat picks one of three, private to the seat: 24 general, 8 per gem. Two held seat augments fuse into a Recipe at the next row.
The trio votes one of three. 38 relics plus 8 Boss relics; one rarity each, never tiered.
One of two framing rules for the half of the map ahead.

augmentLayers.when: Leftovers hour and after any Elite
augmentLayers.t: A fourth option, stronger than Epic, that melts after a set number of fights.
Compendium E.7 stays off. Class is cosmetic in OXP.

ttk.rule: Turns to kill at the party’s expected combo damage for that row; the harness calibrates HP to TTK, not the other way round.

rows.ab: Split: at 50% HP spawns Jelly Blob 80

monsters.label: Bosses · fixed · and the secret row

rows.n: The Blind Judge of the Palate

abilities.t: Reduces damage by its percentage unless armour is ignored.
Each striking seat drains N Nerve every turn the monster is attacked; a Trinity’s Round Delay staggers it for the turn.
Pets spawn at the start of the encounter. Single-target combos hit pets first; AOE hits everything.
At or below 30% HP: +20% damage and the attack timer drops one step at once (min 1). Decided in v2.
Heals N at the end of every turn it survives.
At 50% HP, spawns the named pet once.
Gauge gains are halved while it lives.
Defense drops 10% every time it is hit, to a floor of 0.
Below 50% HP it eats a living pet to heal 150.
Weakness rotates R → G → B at the end of every turn.
The party loses N Nerve at the end of every turn it survives.
Every second turn its Counter is 20 instead of 10.
The party’s buffs and armour breaks last one turn.
Bitter: Counter 20. Sour: gauge halved. Sweet: Regen 60. Rolled when the Critic appears.
×1.25 to a combo whose majority colour matches the weakness, ×0.80 against the resist; a Trinity has no majority and is never tested.

modifiers.t: Counter +5; Counter 5 if it had none.
Buffs and breaks last one turn.
The combo preview line is hidden; the table commits blind.
Steals 10 gauge every turn it survives.

relics.note: The design-doc set. The Compendium (E.3) extends it to 38 plus 8 Boss relics and is canonical for the catalogue.

rows.t: Pure-colour combos deal +10%.
Single-target combos deal +8%.
AOE combos deal +8%.
Start every encounter with +10 gauge.
The first combo of every encounter deals +20%.
A kill on turn 1 pays +50 points.
Counter drains 5 less per seat.
The turn clock is 40 s.
Weakness pays ×1.35 instead of ×1.25.
Buffs and breaks from mixed combos last three turns.
Monsters never Enrage.
Attack timers start one higher, cap 3.
Trinity combos deal +30%.
Hold up to three Limit Tokens.
The mono-gem bonus is +15% instead of +8%.
Four relics offered after every fight instead of three.
Overkill on a pet spills onto the monster.
The first Nerve break of the run costs no life.
Sear at 10% even without a Ruby seat; a Ruby seat’s Sear is +5%.
Any seat may recolour once per encounter.
Every combo ignores +25% Defense.
Weakness and resist are shown for the next two rows of the map before you choose.
Two Limit Breakers per round instead of one.
Gauge gains +50%.
Trinity’s Round Delay adds two turns instead of one.
Every kill grants Grow +3% run damage; stacks with Second Helping.
Counter damage is reflected: the monster takes 50 for every seat it drains.
Bosses take +20%.

groups.label: Boss relics · after rows 5 and 10 · power with a price

rows.t: All combos +25%. Nerve maximum is 70.
The turn clock is 60 s and every attack timer is one higher. Points −20%.
Two relics after every fight. Lives are reduced to one.
Combos deal +35%. The combo preview is hidden for the rest of the run.
Monsters never Enrage and Counter is halved. Gauge gains −30%.
Kills restore Nerve fully and pay +20 gauge. Limit Tokens cannot be banked past the round they are minted.

scoring.turnBonus: +50% for a kill on turn 1, +25% on turn 2

critic: Resists the colour the table committed most that run and is weak to the colour it committed least. Points doubled, drops nothing.

tuning.metric: Nerve lost per fight · Starter / Main / boss
